summary: Full-stack testing of Inked tattoo booking MVP completed. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases passed (auth register/login/me, artists list/filter/detail, bookings create/list/cancel, reviews create+aggregate/list, messages send+auto-reply/threads/fetch-ordered). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): sign-in with demo@inked.dev, sign-up, discover tab (style chip + search filter), artist detail (review modal), 3-step booking flow (date/time/hours -> description -> confirm), booking confirmation, bookings upcoming/past segments, cancel-moves-to-past, messages thread + artist auto-reply, profile shows correct user info, sign out returns to sign-in — ALL PASSED. No deprecated Expo packages found (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch not present). testIDs are comprehensive across all interactive elements.

issues: Chat list is not inverted; newest messages appear at the bottom which is correct, but with more messages the header may push older ones off-screen without auto-scroll-to-bottom on send. Consider FlatList inverted or scrollToEnd on send to match standard chat UX.

action_items: (Optional UX) Auto-scroll chat to bottom (or use inverted FlatList) after send in app/chat/[artistId].tsx.
(Optional) Stripe deposit is MOCKED at flat $50 in backend (server.py:249) and frontend confirmation copy — main agent already noted this; production wire-up deferred.
critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB _id correctly excluded from all reads via {'_id': 0} projection — good.
JWT secret comes from env with a dev fallback (server.py:22). Fine for MVP; ensure production sets JWT_SECRET.
Booking deposit is hardcoded (server.py:249) — acceptable per MVP scope (mocked payments).
Email is lower-cased on register/login (good). Register response returns lowered email — tests updated accordingly.
server.py at 524 lines — within limit; consider splitting into routers/models modules when it grows.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 6 artists on startup automatically. Demo user demo@inked.dev/testpass123 already present. Tests created transient TEST_-prefixed users, bookings, reviews, and messages against the demo user account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse for regression. Frontend uses testIDs consistently (signin-*, signup-*, discover-search-input, style-chip-<lower>, artist-card-<id>, book-*, date-<YYYY-MM-DD>, time-<HH:MM>, hours-<n>, thread-row-<artist_id>, chat-input/send/back, profile-* rows, signout-button).
